pages.setting: An ordinary straight city avenue beginning to fold upward
pages.mainAction: The child and companion watch a rotating street sign as the avenue bends upward like a giant page.
pages.lighting: Clear daytime light shifting across the rising street

pages.setting: The same avenue now standing vertically
pages.mainAction: The companion leaps onto a door handle while the child climbs behind across doors, balconies, and ledges.
pages.lighting: Bright daylight cast sideways across the vertical avenue

pages.setting: The summit of the vertical avenue
pages.mainAction: Viewed from the side, the child pulls open the thin slot in a round marker, splitting it into an arched gate.
pages.lighting: Crisp daylight outlining the narrow slot and opened arch
continuityAnchors: round marker split into two halves

pages.setting: A floating upside-down plaza beyond the arched gate
pages.mainAction: The child holds a cup from the opposite side so a looping stream of lemonade lands inside while the companion tastes it.
pages.lighting: Airy daylight reflected from the floating stone plaza

pages.setting: Open air beneath the inverted plaza and hanging fountain
pages.mainAction: The child and companion leap across solid pigeon shadows that expand and shrink with the birds' wings.
pages.lighting: Strong directional daylight creating dark, crisp shadows in the air

pages.setting: Three adjoining roofs beneath morning, night, and upward-raining skies
pages.mainAction: The child kneels beside three gutters and sets a leaf in their shared silver puddle as it divides into three reflections.
pages.lighting: Mixed pink morning glow, starlight, and silvery rain light
continuityAnchors: three gutters meeting one silver puddle

pages.setting: The same three roofs and their shared silver puddle
pages.mainAction: The child and companion return to different edges of the same puddle after crossing the sunbeam, snoring chimneys, and upward rain.
pages.lighting: Three-way contrast of warm sunrise, deep starlight, and cool rain
continuityAnchors: three gutters meeting one silver puddle
umbrella held beneath their feet on the rain route

pages.setting: The city folding around a large central void
pages.mainAction: The child and companion witness roofs tilt, the plaza rotate, and neighborhoods collide as a house spire plunges into a bakery.
pages.lighting: Dramatic daylight broken across overlapping neighborhood planes
continuityAnchors: vertical avenue folded over another neighborhood

pages.setting: Neighborhood edges gathered around the central void
pages.mainAction: Residents crowd the mismatched edges while the child studies how individually straight streets meet from different directions.
pages.lighting: Even daylight revealing every conflicting plane

pages.setting: A route threading through the wall avenue, circular gate, plaza, and rooftops
pages.mainAction: The child threads a long ribbon through the city while the companion follows it across differently oriented passages and a resident hangs a sock on it.
pages.lighting: Bright daylight carrying consistently across the connected locations
continuityAnchors: ribbon passes through circular gate and across rooftops

pages.setting: The gathered neighborhood edges around the void
pages.mainAction: The companion circles a blue window and discovers its opposite side resembles a round well while its cloud reflection resembles a cauliflower.
pages.lighting: Clear daylight with a bright reflection visible in the cloud

pages.setting: A widening sky gap between separated neighborhood edges
pages.mainAction: The child surveys the circular gate, pigeon shadow, silver gutter, and avenue door scattered around the gap as the stretched ribbon flings its sock away.
pages.lighting: Cool open-sky light filling the widening gap
continuityAnchors: circular gate, pigeon shadow, silver gutter, and avenue door around the gap

pages.setting: The central gap as matching city edges are connected
pages.mainAction: The child directs the connections while the companion crosses from a shadow step to a tunnel and arrives upside down at the bakery.
pages.lighting: Layered daylight and night-sky glow across the joined edges
continuityAnchors: circular gate aligned with avenue door
silver gutter flowing into inverted fountain

pages.setting: The final wide gap at the heart of the city
pages.mainAction: The child unfolds the silver puddle into a mirror sheet across the gap as the neighborhoods tilt until window, well, and cloud reflections meet.
pages.lighting: Soft silver reflected light spreading across the central gap
continuityAnchors: earlier matched connections remain in place
silver puddle unfolded into a mirror sheet
residents standing at their neighborhood edges

pages.mainAction: Residents test the new passages while the child and companion observe roofs serving as bridges and gates opening into new places.
pages.lighting: Warm balanced daylight reaching every side of the completed city
continuityAnchors: mirror crossing spanning the final gap

pages.setting: The original street sign within the stable many-sided city
pages.mainAction: After circling the sign, the child and companion enter a street that appears as stairs, a boat, and a star-tail reflection from different sides.
pages.lighting: Inviting daylight with a bright star-like reflection
